newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta Financial a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta Financial a buy.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said it initiated coverage of Delta Financial Corp with a buy recommendation.
-- The company is a New York-based nonconforming home equity finance company "that appears well-positioned for strong growth and consistent results over the next several years at least."
-- Shares rose 1/4 to 20 in late morning NYSE trade.

-- "At current valuations, we believe that Delta Financial is one of the better investment opportunities in the sector. Specifically, Delta Financial shares currently trade at 14.0 times and 11.6 times our 1996 and 1997 EPS estimates of $1.41 and $1.70, respectively, which compare with average group multiple pf 15.8 times and 12.3 times, respectively," according to NatWest's research note.

-- "Our initial target price range is $24 to $26 per share for potential capital appreciation of 20 to 30 percent. This merely implies the current 1997 price/earnings multiple against our preliminary 1998 EPS estimate of $2.10."
